recipes.name: Fresh Salad Rolls with a Creamy Peanut Hoisin Sauce
instructions: Add the rice noodles and edamame into separate bowls. Pour plenty of boiling water over each. Set aside for 5 minutes, then drain.
Meanwhile, add the sauce ingredients to a small bowl and mix. Add a bit more water if a thinner consistency is desired.

In a large shallow dish, soak 1 sheet of rice paper in lukewarm water for 5 seconds. The paper will continue to soften even after removed from the water. Avoid over-soaking to prevent tearing when rolling.
Let the excess water drip off the paper, then transfer the sheet to a large plate. In a line across the centre, add some rice noodles, edamame, and veggies.
Wrap the salad roll like you would a burrito: folding in the sides, then tucking and rolling. Cut in half using a sharp knife*.
Serve the rolls with the peanut sauce or with a sweet chili sauce, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes * It can help to lightly brush each side of the knife in just a little bit of oil, so that the rice paper and noodles don't stick to the knife.
Storage Store in an airtight container lined with a damp paper towel or cloth in the fridge for up to 3 days.
